query: How do I make microwave spiced pear crisp?

goal.title: Prepare a microwaved pear and oat bowl
goal.description: Rinse, core and slice a pear, combine the slices with brown seasoning, a measured ingredient, oats and liquid, then microwave the bowl and remove it to the counter.
goal.final_state: An orange bowl containing the heated pear slices and oat topping rests on the counter after being removed and briefly displayed. No tasting is shown.

procedure.description: Pick up the pear beside the sink, turn on the faucet and rotate it under the water. Return to the counter, roll and rub it in a paper towel, then carry it to the cutting board. Press and twist the cylindrical corer through its center and withdraw it, leaving a round opening.

Put the corer down and take the large green knife. Hold and rotate the pear with the left hand while repeatedly cutting thin curved slices with the right. Lift the empty orange bowl, put down the knife, transfer the slices into the bowl by hand in several passes and settle them into place.

Retrieve the small black-lidded jar, open its flip top and shake brown ground spice over the pear slices. Close and set the jar aside. Take linked measuring spoons, tip the filled small spoon over the bowl, then hold it in the left hand and repeatedly scrape its contents into the pears with a table knife. Put the spoons and knife down. The small measured ingredient and the jar label are not clear enough to identify confidently.

Open the utensil drawer and retrieve a metal spoon. Hold the bowl with the left hand and turn the slices through the brown coating with the spoon. Set it down on the board, move the small glass aside and reposition the pear slices. Tip a patterned small plate to pour oat flakes over the pears, lower the empty plate, then pour pale liquid from the glass over the oats. Set the glass down and lift the filled bowl.

Carry the bowl to the microwave, open its door and put the bowl on the glass turntable. Close the door, press the keypad to set a two-minute cooking interval and start the microwave. The interior light illuminates and the countdown begins.

Step back and wait beside the running microwave. The bowl remains visible behind the closed door as the display counts down. No further task-object manipulation is visible before the final human fine boundary.

After the source annotation ends, the display reaches the end of its countdown around 234.5s. Open the microwave door at about 235.7s, grip the bowl at 236.5s and lift it out at 237.7s. Close the door, hold the bowl toward the camera to show the pear and oat mixture, then lower it onto the counter around 241s and release it. No eating is shown.
